entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit support. My name is Charlie. How can I help you?
Hi, I need to return my VeloBand Pulse. It's not working.
I can certainly look into that for you. To understand the situation better, is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue with the band?
It's a technical fault. It's defective. The heart rate is inaccurate and now it won't sync at all. The thing is basically broken. I don't want to troubleshoot, I just want to return it.
Okay, I understand. No problem. Let me just pull up your order to check the return eligibility. Can I have the email address you used for the purchase?

Thank you, Sam. One moment... Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor, delivered on December 15th. Let me just review the policy here... yes, it looks like you are well within our 90-day return window.
Good. So you'll send me a return label?

Absolutely. I've just processed the return authorization. You'll receive an email with a prepaid shipping label and instructions within the next few minutes. Just pack it up in the original box and drop it off.
Okay, that's all I needed. Thanks.
You're welcome. Once we receive the item, a full refund will be issued. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
